method: Built-in generation; tools/export-art.mjs 4x4 --clean-bounds crops original alpha; 1x1 override for double bass. Production exports are in public/art/generated; source hashes/crop rectangles are below.
userDirection: Within each category use pictures or words, with a word leader. Preserve the simple casual art direction.

sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production sprite atlas for a casual mobile association card game. Square composition, exactly 4 columns by 4 equal rows; each of 16 cells is an invisible equal square. ONE isolated object per requested cell, centered and entirely contained inside its cell, with generous 15% transparent gutters on all sides. NO cell borders, NO grid, NO labels, NO text. All objects have same simple casual style: chunky broad matte shapes, soft rounded 3D volume, 2–4 main colors, minimal essential details, no tiny fixtures, no noise, no faces added to objects, gentle upper-left lighting, no cast shadow outside silhouette. Readable at 55px. True transparent background. Exact cell order LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM:
1. Свитер
2. Плащ
3. Жилет
4. Кардиган
5. Слива
6. Персик
7. Синица
8. Дятел
9. Скворец
10. Отвёртка
11. Пила
12. Гаечный ключ
13. Плоскогубцы
14. Тарелка
15. Блюдце
16. Кувшин
Specific semantic constraints when applicable: гаечный ключ is an open-ended spanner, not a house key; планер is a slim fixed-wing glider aircraft without a motor; эспандер is two handles joined by short springs, not a long jump rope; скрипка is a small violin with bow, контрабас is an upright double bass; флейта a flute; бра a wall-mounted lamp; блюдце a small shallow saucer, салатник a deep salad bowl; циркуль a geometry compass with two hinged legs, not a navigation compass; кулебяка an elongated closed Russian savory pie, ватрушка an open round pastry with visible white cheese center; гантель a dumbbell, гиря a kettlebell. Do not combine cells or omit cells.
